# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c23 P37](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0037)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie is a heavy-set young woman rather than slim. She is noted for her distinct appearance and bold demeanor around school.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Flossie is spiteful, caustic-tongued, and prone to mocking or challenging others. She lacks imagination and occasionally acts dishonestly, such as peeking at her textbook during spelling tests. Bold and unhesitating when asking questions, she maintains a haughty attitude even after barely squeezing by in her academic endeavors. She is also prone to eavesdropping and spreading malicious comments or jealous rumors.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c16 P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v4 c1 P13](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0013)_

## History

Flossie attended Brierley school, where she frequently clashed with Nell Harcourt and challenged her peers to dares, including daring Nell to walk a kitchen roof ridgepole. She won top prize for knitted lace at a local exhibition. Upon entering Miss Thorne's Regent's class, she struggled with arithmetic but managed to pass the Entrance exam by a slim three-point margin. She subsequently attended the Academy, lodging in town and making a name for herself as the most caustic-tongued student at Regent's while continuing to mock her classmates. Later, her home was used to host a send-off celebration for Nell and Hugh Carrow by the B.V.I.S., where she displayed patronizing friendliness toward Nell. She continued her studies at Regent's for an additional year.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c31 P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 c2 P2](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0002)_
